COMPONENT_SET so "CTA/button" counts every size/state/colour variant as one
TWENTY-FIVE components account for 54,047 placements. That ratio is the whole
story behind the Figma bug backlog: a wrong radius or hex on CTA/button is
wrong 15,560 times, and gets re-reported once per screen a tester opens. Fix
likely   — a code component with a matching name AND role exists; the file
was verified to exist. It has NOT been compared variant-by-variant
against the Figma component set, so treat it as the place to look,
split    — the Figma component maps to more than one code component.
outside  — owned by the MAIN app, not @skai/ui. These are the dangerous ones:
they are shared in Figma but NOT shared in code, so they drift per
surface with nothing to stop them.
none     — no code owner identified. Either unbuilt or unfindable by name.
Paths are relative to modules/skai-ui unless marked (main).
★ icons/* is 27,591 of the 54,047 placements — over half the design system is
icons. src/figma-icons.tsx exports 90 `Figma*Icon` components, described in
src/icons.ts as "traced from the design file... what parity is measured
against". Whether those 90 cover the six icons/* Figma sets is UNVERIFIED and
is the single most valuable thing to check next.

that NEVER RENDER, which is the worst kind of wrong for an ownership table:
a developer opens the cited file, edits it, and nothing changes on screen.
Header-*        was src/components/layout/Header.tsx. That is gated at

Bottom-nav-*    was src/components/ai/MobileBottomNav.tsx — the 7.9 KB AI-only
one mounted solely by src/pages/ai/AIAgent.tsx. The main shell
BOTH bottom navs ship simultaneously. That is a real duplication to resolve,
Lesson for the rest of this table: a file existing and having a matching name
does not make it the owner. Check whether the route/shell actually MOUNTS it,
and whether a feature flag has retired it.
